# The dead code ledger: per-package count of functions unreachable from the
# module's production mains (every main under ./cmd/... and ./tools/...).
# Held by TestDeadCode in internal/ci/dead_code_test.go (go test -tags functional).
# Measured with deadcode -test under GOOS linux, darwin and windows; a function
# counts when it is unreachable under every tag set the module uses, and the
# count is the union over the GOOSes.

# raises a count or adds a row.
